title: Hypixel Skyblock XP Boost Potions
description: Adds custom textures for Hypixel Skyblock's XP Boost Potions
body: Have you ever found it hard to tell which XP Boost Potion is which? Not anymore! This Resource Pack adds custom textures for all 7 types of XP Boost Potions so you'll never need to worry about which is which again.
